_comment: Copied to apps.json on first run. It registers this tool with itself, so portable-sideloader is updated by the same machinery as everything else. Delete the entry if you would rather update it by hand.

apps.name: portable-sideloader
apps.notes: self:true means updates are staged into Data\update\ and applied by the launcher on next start, because a running process cannot overwrite its own files. The installed version is read from App\VERSION.
